1smzohh.description_en:
We need any available security personnel to report to [LOCATION]. A group of armed individuals have attacked one of our outpost clusters and we're in desperate need of help. Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is [TARGET], a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.
Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and [TARGET].
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

A rather creative former contractor of ours with a knack for staging accidents was so swept up in their work that they forgot to confirm the death of [TARGET] for us.

Vaughn

你到达地点时可得小心点。要是有几个秃鹫在附近转悠，我一点都不会惊讶。

此致，
沃恩

Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

Hey,
Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.
Can you fly out to [LOCATION] and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.
Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we'll send confirmation to the client.
Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.
Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. 1xslhsq.description_en:
Hi there,
The refinery at [LOCATION] has been busy. They’ve processed a bunch of Quartz into containers 16 SCU or smaller, and are looking to get it shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see which ones needed this stuff and was able to put together this run.
DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION1]
- Freight elevator at [DESTINATION2]
Should be an easy run for you, if you’re free.
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
